tameable-ocelots.config.ocelotTamingItem: Change or add the items required to tame a ocelot.
tameable-ocelots.config.ocelotBreedingIt: Change or add the items required to breed a ocelot.
tameable-ocelots.config.ocelotsAttackWit: If true, ocelots will attack the mobs owner hits.
tameable-ocelots.config.ocelotsTameDirec: If false, ocelots can only be tamed by breeding them.
tameable-ocelots.config.ocelotsCanIgnore: If true, ocelots will still pick items even if /gamerule mobGriefing set to false.
tameable-ocelots.config.ocelotsTrustOnBo: If true, when two ocelots are bred, the baby will directly trust you and be tamed.
tameable-ocelots.config.untamedocelotsCa: If true, untamed ocelots will follow you when you hold taming/breeding items of Ocelots.
tameable-ocelots.config.convertToCat.des: If true, it'll change the taming behavior back to the old Minecraft versions of taming ocelots.
